data.name: Alfi
data.gender_notes: Alfi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Alfios, meaning 'noble, man of God'. In the New Testament, Alpheus is the name of one of the twelve apostles. The name Alfi carries the meaning “God's man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alfi usually hope their child will grow to embody god's man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reflecting devotion to God.
data.etymology: Alfi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alfi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: עלפי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בעברית: עלפי (על-פי, 'לפי') הוא צורה קצרה של 'על-פי' שפירושה 'כפי ש' או 'לפי' (בעבר: 'לְפִי'). על-פי' (בעבר: 'עָלֵי פִי') הוא צורה של ציווי של האל, שהוא אומר 'על-פי' (כלומר, 'כפי' ש) ה' התבטא' (כלומר, 'על-פי' 'ה' (א-ל-ה) 'התבטא'). בעבר, 'על-פי' (בעבר: 'עָלֵי פִי') היה צורה של 'על-פי' (כלומר, 'כפי' ש) 'ב-בת-שבע' (כלומר, 'ב-שבע') 'ש-ש-ו-ס' (כלומר, 'ש-ש-וש').

in_greek.name: Αλφί
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἕλληνικά: Ἀλφί (Alphi) ἡ εἰσαγωγὴ τοῦ Ἀλφα (Alfa) εἰσάγει τούς ἀνθρώπους εἰς τὴν ἄπαντα αὐτοῦ τῆς ἐπιστημοῦ. Ἀλφί (Alphi) εἰσαγωγὴ τοῦ Ἀλφα (Alfa) εἰσάγει τούς ἀνθρώπους εἰς τὴν ἄπαντα ἀπὸ τῆς ἀρχῆς. Ὅταν ἡ ἡμέρα ἄρχει, τότε ἡ ἀπάντηση εἵναι ἄλφα (Alfa).

in_latin.name: Alfi
in_latin.long_meaning: Latin: Alfi significat 'brevis, minor, parvus, exigens.' In contextu religioso, Alfi potest referri ad 'parvum, exigens, brevis.'
